About.metaTitle: About us — a partnership intermediary and master IB, not a broker
About.metaDescription: Who is behind FX Partners, how we get paid, and how we decide what appears on the site: our licence methodology, our ratings policy, and what we will never write about a broker we have not verified.
About.h1: A partnership intermediary and master IB — not a broker
About.weAre1: A partnership intermediary and master IB (Master IB) under contract with licensed brokers.
About.weAre2: We negotiate terms for a group, so an agent or a trader gets what an individual on their own would not.
About.weAre3: We run a network of sub-agents (Sub-IB) and give them operational support and follow-up.
About.weAre4: We publish a comparison of brokers, their licences and their terms.
About.weAreNot1: We are not a broker and not an execution venue.
About.weAreNot2: We take no deposits and hold no client money.
About.weAreNot3: We do not open trading accounts and we do not execute trades.
About.weAreNot4: We give no investment advice and no trading recommendations.
About.earnBody1: Brokers pay us a commission on the activity of clients who open their accounts through us. That commission comes out of the spread or the commission the broker charges anyway — it is not an extra fee on you, and it does not raise your cost of trading.
About.earnBody2: It also means we have a financial interest in some of the brokers listed here. So we label contracted brokers clearly, we list brokers we have no contract with, and we leave the rating to reviews rather than to us. The rule we hold to: you should know in what capacity we are speaking before you decide.
About.policyTitle: How we decide what is listed
About.policyLead: Five rules enforced in the code that builds these pages — not stated intentions.
About.policy1Title: A licence belongs to an entity, not to a brand name
About.policy1Body: Most brokers operate through several legal entities under different regulators. We show each licence attributed to its entity, because the licence that protects a client is the one held by the entity their account is opened with — not the strongest one on the list.
About.policy2Body: If we have not verified a spread, a bonus or a minimum deposit, we leave it blank. We do not put in an estimate, and we do not put in a dash that reads like a statement. The interface hides empty fields rather than filling them.
About.policy3Title: Ratings come from real reviews only
About.policy3Body: The rating and the review count are built from real user reviews and are never written by hand. A broker with no reviews shows as “not yet rated” — not as zero, because a zero reads as a bad score.
About.policy4Title: No invented testimonials and no invented partners
About.policy4Body: We do not publish made-up client opinions, and we do not name brokers we have no contract with as partners. A section with no real content does not appear at all.
About.policy5Body: Brokers we hold an agreement with carry a “verified partner” label. We also list brokers we have no agreement with, and they appear without one — so that a comparison is a comparison, not a client list.
About.risk: Risk warning: leveraged trading carries a risk of losing your capital. The content on this site is for information only and is not investment advice.
About.companyIntro: This is the entity responsible for this site and for the data described in the privacy policy, and whose country's law governs the terms and conditions.

Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before joining the partner program.
Faq.q1: How do I start as an IB or marketing partner?
Faq.a1: Create a free account in minutes. Once approved, you get an agent code and referral links you can share right away.
Faq.a2: We offer a revenue share of up to 60%, or a fixed amount per qualified client (CPA), plus a multi-tier Sub-IB system. The rate that applies to you is set out in your partner agreement.
Faq.q3: When and how do I receive my earnings?
Faq.a3: Your earnings accrue automatically in your wallet, and you can request withdrawals via bank transfer, crypto, or e-wallets — processed quickly and transparently.
Faq.q4: How do I track my referral performance?
Faq.a4: From the dashboard you track clicks, signups, trading volume, and earnings per campaign through live charts and detailed tables.
Faq.a5: Yes. We enforce strict row-level security (RLS) in the database, so your data is isolated and only you can access it.

FaqHome.heading: Frequently asked questions
FaqHome.subheading: Before you choose a broker — or join us as an agent.
FaqHome.a1: No. We are a partnership intermediary (master IB): we do not open trading accounts, take deposits or hold anyone's money. Your account is opened directly with the broker.
FaqHome.q2: How do you make money, and do I pay more if I sign up through you?
FaqHome.a2: Brokers pay us a commission out of the spread or fee they already charge on the activity of clients who sign up through us. We add no charge and do not raise your trading costs.
FaqHome.q3: Where do the ratings come from?
FaqHome.a3: Star ratings are calculated from approved client reviews only; a broker with no reviews shows as not rated yet. Any data from an external source is labelled unverified.
FaqHome.q4: How do I check a broker's licence before depositing?
FaqHome.a4: Find the legal entity your account will be opened with in the account agreement, then look it up on the regulator's own register (such as the FCA, ASIC or CySEC). A licence follows the entity, not the brand.
FaqHome.q5: I am an IB — how do I join the network?
FaqHome.a5: Create a partner account from the agent programme page; once approved you get an agent code and referral links. Commission models and rates are set out in the partnership agreement.

Privacy.metaDescription: What FX Partners collects, why, who else sees it, how long it is kept and what your rights are — written against what the site actually does.
Privacy.s1Title: 1) Who is responsible for your data
Privacy.s1p1: The entity operating this site is the controller of the data described here. Its legal details and address are published on the About page, and the way to reach it about privacy is in the last section below.
Privacy.s1p2: FX Partners is a partnership intermediary and master IB, not a broker: we do not open trading accounts and we take no deposits. When you go through to a broker via our links, that broker becomes an independent controller of your data and its policy applies, not ours.
Privacy.s2p1: Visitors: we ask you for nothing in order to browse. A few simple preferences are kept in your browser (language, light or dark theme, notices you dismissed) and are never sent to us. They are listed individually in the cookie policy.
Privacy.s2p2: Contact and booking forms: your name, email address and the text of your message; the meeting booking form also takes a company name, a contact name and a phone number if you give one. These are the fields we need in order to reply, and we ask for nothing else.
Privacy.s2p3: Reviews and forum posts: the name or pseudonym you choose and the text you write. What you post is public — do not put anything in it you would not want read. Voting on posts creates a random identifier kept only in your browser to stop double voting; it is not linked to your name or email.
Privacy.s2p4: Agent accounts: your name and email at registration, then your activity as an agent (referrals, commission, withdrawal requests) and the payment details you give us so we can pay you.
Privacy.s2p5: Click statistics: when a referral link is clicked we record the link code, a country code and the site you came from. We do not store your IP address with these records, or any personal identifier.
Privacy.s2p6: The attribution cookie: if you allow the “referral attribution” category we set a 30-day cookie remembering which agent you arrived through. If you do not, no cookie is set and the link still works.
Privacy.s3Title: 3) Why we use it, and on what basis
Privacy.s3p1: To answer the message or meeting request you sent: the basis is taking steps at your request before entering a contract, or our legitimate interest in replying to people who write to us.
Privacy.s3p2: To run an agent account and calculate and pay commission: the basis is performance of our contract with you, and legal obligation as regards keeping financial records.
Privacy.s3p3: To publish your review or post: the basis is your consent, given by submitting the form, which you can withdraw by asking us to remove what you posted.
Privacy.s3p4: To measure site performance, to attribute referrals, and to load external content: the basis is your consent alone, and none of it runs before you give it.
Privacy.s3p5: We make no automated decision that produces a legal effect on you, we build no behavioural profiles, we do not sell your data, and we do not use it for targeted advertising.
Privacy.s4p1: Supabase — our database, authentication and file storage. Every account, review, post and commission record we hold lives there.
Privacy.s4p2: Vercel — hosting. It processes page requests, and provides the performance measurement that is conditional on your consent.
Privacy.s4p3: Resend — sending operational email (welcome, withdrawal confirmation, monthly report). It receives your email address and the content of the message.
Privacy.s4p4: Telegram — an important disclosure: when you submit the contact form or the meeting booking form, a copy of your name, email and message (and your phone number and company name on the booking form) is sent to our team's Telegram chat, because that is the alerting channel we work from. If you would rather your details did not pass through Telegram, write to us directly at the address on the Contact page instead of using the form.
Privacy.s4p5: Brokers — we do not send them your personal data. What a broker receives is that you arrived through a particular agent's link, at the point where you open an account with them yourself.
Privacy.s4p6: External content — if you allow the “external content” category, loading TradingView charts, Binance prices or the currency-rate provider reveals your IP address and browser to those companies. Each has its own privacy policy, linked from the cookie policy.
Privacy.s4p7: We may disclose data where the law requires it, to defend our rights in a dispute, or to prevent fraud in the commission system.
Privacy.s5p1: The providers named above run servers in the United States, Europe and elsewhere, which means your data may be processed outside the country you live in. Where EU or UK law applies, we rely for those transfers on the standard contractual clauses those providers offer within our data-processing agreements with them.
Privacy.s6p1: Contact messages and meeting requests: up to 24 months from our last exchange, then deleted.
Privacy.s6p2: Agent accounts and commission records: for as long as the account is active, then for the period financial record-keeping requirements impose after it closes.
Privacy.s6p3: Reviews and forum posts: they stay published until you ask us to remove them or they breach the posting rules.
Privacy.s6p4: Click records: up to 24 months. They are aggregate by construction and carry no personal identifier.
Privacy.s7p1: Every cookie and storage key the site uses, with its purpose and lifetime, is listed one by one in the cookie policy. Nothing non-essential runs before you consent, and you can change your consent at any time from the Cookies link in the footer of every page.
Privacy.s8p1: You may ask for a copy of your data, or for it to be corrected, deleted or restricted; you may object to processing we carry out on the basis of legitimate interest; and you may ask for your data in a portable format. Where processing rests on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of what was done before you withdrew it.
Privacy.s8p2: We answer within one month. We do not charge for this, and we may ask you to confirm your identity before acting on a request about an account.
Privacy.s8p3: If you think we have not handled your request properly, you may complain to the data protection authority in your country. We would ask you to come to us first so we can try to put it right directly.
Privacy.s9p1: All requests are carried over HTTPS. The database enforces row-level security so one user cannot read another's data, and administrative operations run through narrowly defined functions rather than broad access. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your rights we will notify you and the supervisory authority as the law requires.
Privacy.s10p1: This site is for adults. We do not offer our services to anyone under 18 and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you know that a minor has given us their details, tell us and we will delete them.
Privacy.s11p1: We may update this page if what we do with data changes. The last-updated date is at the top, and it moves only when the text actually changes. We will announce any material change on the site.
Privacy.s12p1: For any privacy question or request, write to us through the Contact page or at the address published there, with “privacy request” in the subject so we can deal with it quickly.

Cookies.metaDescription: Every cookie and storage key FX Partners actually uses: purpose, category and lifetime — and how to change your consent at any time.
Cookies.intro: This page lists every cookie and every piece of browser storage this site actually uses — not a generic list, but what is in the code. The necessary ones always run, because the site does not work without them. Nothing else runs until you allow it, and we do not treat browsing as agreement.
Cookies.changeBody: You can change your choice at any time from the button below, or from the Cookies link in the footer of every page. You can also delete anything already stored from your browser's settings.
Cookies.storageIntro: The items below are kept in your browser (localStorage / sessionStorage) and are never sent to our servers. All of them are functional and serve something you asked for, and you can clear them from your browser settings.
Cookies.thirdIntro: Some sections of the site are loaded from third parties. Loading them alone reveals your IP address and browser to that company, and they may set their own cookies under their own policies. That is why those sections do not load until you have allowed “external content”, and show a button to allow them in the meantime.
Cookies.noAdsBody: We set no advertising cookies, we do not sell your data, we use no ad-tracking networks, and we do not follow you across other sites. The one attribution cookie exists so the agent who introduced you gets credited — nothing more.

Payouts.metaDescription: How agent commission is calculated, when it is paid, the minimum withdrawal, and when it can be clawed back — and why this site has no refund policy.
Payouts.noRefundTitle: Why there is no refund policy
Payouts.noRefundBody: Because this site sells nothing and takes no payment from you. There are no subscriptions, no registration fees and no deposits — we are a partnership intermediary, and money does not flow from you to us; it flows from us to agents as commission. What this platform needs is therefore not a refund policy but a clear payment policy, which is below. If anyone ever asks you to pay to join as an agent through FX Partners, it is not us — tell us immediately.
Payouts.brokerDepositsTitle: Money you hold with a broker
Payouts.brokerDepositsBody: If you deposit money with a broker after following one of our links, that money is with the broker and not with us. Deposits, withdrawals and any dispute about them are governed solely by that broker's terms and its regulator, and we have no authority to move or return your funds. If you have a financial problem with a broker we can help escalate your complaint to them, because of our contractual relationship — but the decision remains theirs.
Payouts.s1p1: Commission is credited to the agent through whose referral link the client opened their broker account, according to that broker's own attribution mechanism. The rates shown on the partner programme page are indicative; the binding rate is the one in the partner agreement you have signed.
Payouts.s1p2: No commission is earned on an account an agent opens for themselves or for an immediate family member, or on accounts created to generate commission without genuine trading activity.
Payouts.s2p1: Commission becomes payable once the broker has confirmed it to us and settled it with us. We cannot pay out commission we have not received, which is why the payment schedule follows the broker's settlement cycle rather than the date of the client's activity.
Payouts.s2p2: Commission appears in your dashboard wallet as soon as it is confirmed, showing the period it relates to.
Payouts.s3p1: Withdrawal requests are processed monthly, after settlement with the brokers is complete, within the period stated in the dashboard at the time you make the request. We do not publish a fixed turnaround here because it depends on the payment method and on each broker's settlement cycle, and we will not commit to a number we might not meet.
Payouts.s3p2: A minimum withdrawal amount is published in the dashboard. A balance below the minimum stays in your wallet and rolls into the next cycle; it is not forfeited.
Payouts.s3p3: Transfer fees charged by the payment provider are deducted from the withdrawal amount unless stated otherwise when you make the request.
Payouts.s4p1: If a broker reclaims commission it previously paid us — because of a reversed deposit, fraud, wash trading, or the client breaching the broker's terms — the corresponding amount is deducted from your balance. If it has already been paid to you, it is deducted from your following commission.
Payouts.s4p2: We may temporarily hold a balance under review if a broker reports a suspicion to us, until that broker closes its investigation. We will tell you in writing that we have done so and why.
Payouts.s5p1: Commission is forfeited, and the account may be closed, in cases including: impersonating FX Partners or a broker, promising guaranteed profits, misleading advertising, using someone's details without their knowledge, or breaching a broker's terms or the rules that apply in the client's country.
Payouts.s6p1: If you disagree with a calculated amount, write to us through the Contact page within 60 days of it appearing in your wallet, quoting the client reference or the period in dispute. We will review the statement with the broker and come back to you with the outcome and the document we relied on.
Payouts.s7p1: Commission is your income, and you are responsible for declaring it and paying any tax due on it where you live. We do not withhold tax on your behalf and we do not give tax advice.

BestFor.indexMetaTitle: Best brokers for what you actually need
BestFor.indexMetaDescription: Lists built from the brokers' own data: best for Islamic accounts, for beginners, for low spreads, for scalping, for automated trading, for hedging, for gold, and the most regulated.
BestFor.indexTitle: Best brokers — by what matters to you
BestFor.indexLead: There is no broker that is best for everyone. These are lists ordered by one stated rule each, built from broker data we have verified — not from an opinion.
BestFor.indexEmpty: Not enough broker data has been published yet to build any list. They appear automatically once brokers carrying these specifications are added.
BestFor.unratedNote: An unrated broker appears here because its data qualified it, but it does not move ahead of one with real reviews.
BestFor.islamicTitle: Best brokers for an Islamic account
BestFor.islamicDescription: Brokers offering a swap-free Islamic account, ordered by lowest minimum deposit.
BestFor.islamicRule: offers an Islamic account, then lowest minimum deposit first
BestFor.islamicIntro: An Islamic account means overnight swap interest is removed. The conditions differ between brokers — some charge an administrative fee instead, or cap how long the exemption lasts — so check the terms with the broker itself before opening one.
BestFor.beginnersDescription: Brokers with a minimum deposit of $100 or less, ordered by the lowest.
BestFor.beginnersRule: minimum deposit of $100 or less, then lowest first
BestFor.beginnersIntro: One explicit criterion here: how much you need to start. We do not rank how “friendly” a platform is, because that is an opinion we have no way to measure. Start with an amount you could lose in full.
BestFor.low-spreadDescription: Brokers whose spread we have verified, ordered from lowest.
BestFor.low-spreadIntro: The figure shown is the lowest advertised spread, not an average. It widens around news and when liquidity thins, and it may come alongside a separate commission — compare the full cost rather than the headline number.
BestFor.scalpingDescription: Brokers that explicitly permit scalping, ordered by lowest spread.
BestFor.scalpingRule: permits scalping, then lowest spread first
BestFor.scalpingIntro: Scalping is a cost game before it is anything else. Permission in the terms does not mean there are no limits on holding time or execution speed — read the trading conditions.
BestFor.automatedDescription: Brokers supporting expert advisors and automated trading, ordered by lowest spread.
BestFor.automatedRule: supports automated trading, then lowest spread first
BestFor.automatedIntro: EA support means expert advisors are allowed to run on the platform. Execution quality and slippage decide the outcome far more than permission does, and a demo account tells you more than any table.
BestFor.hedgingDescription: Brokers allowing opposing positions on the same instrument, ordered by lowest spread.
BestFor.hedgingRule: allows hedging, then lowest spread first
BestFor.hedgingIntro: Hedging means holding two opposing positions on the same instrument in one account. The rule depends on the legal entity your account is opened with, not on the brand name.
BestFor.goldDescription: Brokers offering gold (XAU/USD), ordered by lowest spread.
BestFor.goldRule: offers gold trading, then lowest spread first
BestFor.goldIntro: Gold is a high-volatility instrument and its spread widens faster than the major currency pairs. The figure here is the broker's advertised spread generally, not its gold spread specifically, unless stated.
BestFor.regulatedDescription: Brokers ordered by the number of regulators we have verified.
BestFor.regulatedIntro: Holding several licences does not mean the strongest one protects you. What protects you is the licence held by the specific entity your account is opened with — check the entity named in your account agreement, not the row of logos.
BestFor.upcomingNote: This list appears once enough verified data exists to build it — we do not fill it with guesses.

Methodology.metaDescription: How the “best for” lists are ordered, where the star rating comes from, and what we refuse to score at all — rules enforced in code rather than written as intentions.
Methodology.h1: How we rate and rank brokers
Methodology.lead: A page titled “best broker for X” is a claim, not a heading. This page explains the basis on which we make it, so you can judge the ranking rather than take it on trust.
Methodology.s1Title: 1) Ranking is one stated rule, not an opinion
Methodology.s1p1: Every “best for” list is built on a single column we actually store, and a single ordering rule printed at the top of the page itself. No list is hand-curated, and no position in one can be bought.
Methodology.s1p2: The rule is always the thing the reader came for: the Islamic-account page orders by minimum deposit, the scalping page orders by spread. We rank by stars only to break a tie — the rating is a tie-breaker, never the primary criterion.
Methodology.s1p3: A broker is on a list because its data put it there. If the column the list rests on is missing for a broker, it does not appear — we do not guess a missing value.
Methodology.s2Title: 2) Where the star rating comes from
Methodology.s2p1: The rating and review count are computed from approved user reviews in the database and recalculated automatically whenever one is approved or removed. They are never written by hand, and no administrator can type a number in.
Methodology.s2p2: A broker with no reviews shows as “not yet rated”, not as zero — a zero reads as a bad score, which is the opposite of the truth.
Methodology.s2p3: Every review is moderated before publication. We remove advertising, defamation and duplicates. We do not remove a review for being negative.
Methodology.s3p1: We give no score for “platform ease”, “support quality” or “execution speed”. These are either things we have no objective way to measure, or things that change with your country, your account and the hour you trade. Putting a number on them lends them a precision they do not have.
Methodology.s3p2: We publish no spread, bonus or minimum deposit we have not verified. An unverified field stays empty, and the interface hides it rather than filling it with a dash that reads like a statement.
Methodology.s4Title: 4) A licence belongs to an entity, not a brand
Methodology.s4p1: Most brokers operate through several legal entities under different regulators. We show each licence attributed to its entity. The “most regulated” list counts the regulators we have verified — it is a measure of breadth, not of protection.
Methodology.s4p2: What protects you is the licence held by the specific entity your account is opened with. Check the entity named in your account agreement and look it up on the regulator's register, rather than reading the row of logos.
Methodology.s5Title: 5) Our financial relationship with brokers, and what it does to the ranking
Methodology.s5p1: We receive a commission when you open an account through our links. That means we hold a financial interest in some of the brokers listed, and it is a fair reason to question whether the ranking is honest.
Methodology.s5p2: So: ordering runs on a column of data and not on whether an agreement exists, contracted brokers are labelled plainly, and we list brokers we have no agreement with at all. There is no position on any list that is for sale.
Methodology.s6p1: Lists are built from broker data at request time, so they change the moment the data does. There is no frozen copy and no hand-saved order.
Methodology.s6p2: A list that no broker qualifies for is not published at all — no empty page, and nothing linking to one.
Methodology.s7p1: If a figure on this site is out of date or incorrect, write to us through the Contact page with the broker, the field and the correct source. We will fix it and move the last-updated date.
